about.heading: About Me
about.name: Rohan Shrestha
about.role: Flutter & Node.js Developer | Full Stack Mobile App Developer
about.intro: I'm a software developer based in Nepal focused on building reliable mobile applications and backend systems that solve real product problems. My work spans Flutter and Dart for Android and iOS, Node.js for REST APIs and server-side logic, and modern app architecture for scalability, maintainability, and clean delivery.
about.quote: I focus on building dependable products through solid architecture, thoughtful API design, and practical engineering decisions that support long-term growth.
about.certifications: My work includes cross-platform app development, API integration, state management, backend development, and production-ready mobile engineering for startups and growing product teams.

technicalExperience.description: Developing production-grade Flutter applications for business products, translating requirements into scalable features, integrating REST APIs, and improving app stability and maintainability across Android and iOS.

Built and improved mobile application features for a ride-sharing product, contributed to API-driven workflows, and helped refine performance and user experience through maintainable app architecture.

Supported feature implementation, bug fixes, and UI refinements while gaining hands-on experience with Flutter workflows, version control, and quality-focused app development in a collaborative environment.
Delivered a patient-side hospital management mobile application by implementing core features, integrating backend services, and shaping a reliable cross-platform product for real-world use.

communityExperience.description: Contributed to open-source and community initiatives that supported collaboration, technical learning, and developer engagement in Nepal’s growing technology ecosystem.

communityExperience.description: Represented the college in technology-focused initiatives, coordinating events and helping students connect with practical software development opportunities.
Participated in community-driven programs focused on using technology for social impact, mentorship, and collaborative learning.
Engaged with the Flutter community in Kathmandu through meetups and knowledge-sharing sessions that strengthened technical growth and networking.

posts.title: Stop Guessing How Your App Looks on Other Devices — This Flutter Package Changed Everything.
posts.excerpt: As a Flutter developer, one of the biggest challenges I faced was ensuring that my app looked great on all devices. With so many different screen sizes and resolutions, it was nearly impossible to predict how my app would render on every device. That’s when I discovered the Flutter Device Preview package, and it completely changed the way I develop apps.
